description: This file defines configuration options, default methods, and validation for Redis clustering within an Orleans-based system. It includes the RedisClusteringOptions class with properties for configuration, connection multiplexer creation, Redis key generation, and entry expiry. It also provides default implementations and a configuration validator.

classes.name: RedisClusteringOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Redis clustering, including configuration settings, connection factory delegates, and entry expiry.

classes.name: RedactRedisConfigurationOptions
classes.description: A helper class for redacting sensitive Redis configuration details, inheriting from RedactAttribute.

classes.name: RedisClusteringOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the RedisClusteringOptions instance ensuring it has necessary configuration, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a Redis connection multiplexer using the specified configuration options.

methods.name: DefaultCreateRedisKey
methods.description: Generates a Redis key for the membership table based on cluster options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the ConfigurationOptions property is set; throws exception if not.
